name: candela-gallery
notes: Candela's fixed kernel and the gallery's 18 scene sections, generated by tools/gen/candela/kernel-typed.mjs (regenerate.mjs).

candela_typed_p4.c compiles it on the gallery's first use after a firmware update (85 s, in the background while the C++ kernel draws), reads it from the compiled-module cache afterwards, and binds it as a renderer-core instance.
Typed is the playable gallery's default kernel; C++ (gallery arm cpp) is the benchmark.
